title: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries
summary: REA (Reverse Engineering Agent) is an AI-powered tool that uses autonomous agents to automate reverse engineering tasks, capable of analyzing both application behavior and native binaries through an agent-based architecture.
problem_solved: Automates the time-consuming and complex process of reverse engineering software by leveraging AI agents to analyze binaries and app behavior.
why_valuable: democratizes reverse engineering by making it more accessible to developers and security researchers who lack deep expertise in binary analysis.
